scope: Evaluation methodology for R5 registry entries: how each 26-week verdict is computed and published. The signal rule (z(MVRV) < -0.5 -> LONG 26 weeks, else FLAT) and the data source (amendment v2.2) are unchanged.
disclosure: No success criterion was pre-registered in the R5 protocol (paper v1.3: results reported regardless of outcome). This amendment is declared after interim prices for entries 001-016 were publicly observable. To leave no room for a favourable choice, it fixes only mechanical definitions and deliberately sets NO pass/fail threshold: verdicts are reported as numbers.

method.entry_price: the 'price' field recorded in the entry as published (never recomputed)
method.exit_price: Coin Metrics Community API v4, metric PriceUSD, frequency=1d, the value dated exactly eval_due
method.trigger: a verdict is computed as soon as the exit price is available for every asset of the entry; until then the entry is pending
method.baskets: equal-weight arithmetic mean of asset returns: LONG basket, FLAT basket, universe (all assets of the entry)
reported_metrics: LONG hit rate (share of LONG assets with return > 0)
method.empty_basket: if an entry has no LONG (or no FLAT) asset, the metrics that need it are reported as null, with no substitute
method.costs: returns are gross: no fees, slippage or funding
method.independence: entries 001 and 002 are subsets of entry 003 (same 2026-05-29 observation). They are evaluated separately because they are separate registry records, but they count as one observation.

publication: each verdict is written to registry/verdict_entryNNN.json, embeds the evaluated entry's sha256, carries its own sha256, and is timestamped with OpenTimestamps like registry entries. Verdicts are published whatever the outcome.
